raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

In multi-turn benchmarks (`--dataset-name agentic-trace`, or any dataset whose `prompt` is a list of turns), each turn is sent as a separate request, so `calculate_metrics` is called with `input_requests=None`. Input tokens are only added up inside `if input_requests is not None`, so these runs print:

- `Total input tokens: 0` and `Total input text tokens: 0`
- `Input token throughput: 0`
- a `Total token throughput` that leaves out input tokens

The JSONL output has the same zeros in `total_input_tokens`, `input_throughput` and `total_throughput`.

This is the input-token counting part of #30304, submitted on its own. #30304 was closed without being merged. #29215 added the `agentic-trace` loader but did not change this code. #39889 stores the server-reported prompt length in `RequestFuncOutput.prompt_len` (used by `--cache-report` and the JSON `input_lens`), but the summary totals still read `input_requests[i].prompt_len`. So the per-turn prompt length is already available on each output; it just is not added to the total.

`input_lens` in `--output-file --output-details` needs no change: on current main it is `[output.prompt_len for output in outputs]`, which #39889 already fills from `usage.prompt_tokens` / `meta_info.prompt_tokens`.

## Modifications

Only `calculate_metrics` in `python/sglang/benchmark/serving.py` changes. When `input_requests is None`, the `prompt_len` of each successful output is added to `total_input` and `total_input_text`. Vision tokens stay 0. Single-turn runs still use the dataset row, so their numbers do not change. No new flags.

A CPU-only unit test is added at `test/registered/unit/bench/test_bench_serving_multiturn_input_metrics.py` (registered in the `base-a-test-cpu` suite). It calls `calculate_metrics` directly and covers: multi-turn with server usage, failed requests not counted, single-turn totals unchanged, and the fallback when the server returns no usage.

## Limitations

- If the server returns no usage (for example `stream_options.include_usage=false`), each round's `prompt_len` stays at the dataset row value, so the multi-turn total is an estimate, not an exact count. This fallback already exists on main (`--cache-report` sums the same field); this PR does not change it. The unit test documents this behaviour.
- Multi-turn prompts are assumed to be text. If a round contains images, image tokens are counted in `total_input_text` and `total_input_vision` stays 0. `total_input` is still correct.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable. This only changes benchmark reporting; no model or kernel code is touched.

## How to test

Run the command below against the same server twice: once on current main and once with this change. `BASE_URL` is an OpenAI-compatible SGLang endpoint, `MODEL` is the served model name, `TOKENIZER` is a local tokenizer or model directory, and `agentic_sample.json` is an agentic-trace file.

```bash
python3 -m sglang.benchmark.serving \
  --backend sglang-oai-chat \
  --base-url "$BASE_URL" \
  --model "$MODEL" \
  --tokenizer "$TOKENIZER" \
  --dataset-name agentic-trace \
  --dataset-path agentic_sample.json \
  --num-prompts 4 \
  --sharegpt-output-len 8 \
  --max-concurrency 1 \
  --request-rate inf \
  --warmup-requests 0 \
  --output-file multi.jsonl
```

On main, `Total input tokens` and `Input token throughput` are 0. With this change, `Total input tokens` equals the sum of `prompt_len` over all successful turns (the server's `usage.prompt_tokens` when it is returned). Output tokens are unchanged. Single-turn runs are also unchanged: a random-dataset run of 10 requests x 128 input tokens reported 1280 both before and after.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Inference speed is not affected. For multi-turn runs, the reported input and total throughput go up because input tokens are now counted.

Results of the command above on a GLM-5 deployment (4 conversations x 4 turns; it was run through the older `python3 -m sglang.bench_serving` entry point, which forwards to `sglang.benchmark.serving`):

| | before | after |
|---|---:|---:|
| completed requests | 16 | 16 |
| output tokens | 128 | 128 |
| Total input tokens | 0 | 4692 |
| input throughput (tok/s) | 0 | 64.25 |
| total throughput (tok/s) | 1.60 | 66.01 |

As a cross-check, summing `usage.prompt_tokens` from non-streaming requests for the same 16 turns gave 4694. The 2-token difference comes from how the chat template is counted in streaming and non-streaming mode; no turn is missing.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

No documentation page was added; the limitations are noted above and in the code comment. The new test passes locally (4 tests, CPU only). The changed files were checked with the isort and ruff versions pinned in `.pre-commit-config.yaml`.

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -1168,6 +1168,13 @@ def calculate_metrics(
                 total_input += input_requests[i].prompt_len
                 total_input_text += input_requests[i].text_prompt_len
                 total_input_vision += input_requests[i].vision_prompt_len
+            else:
+                # Multi-turn outputs are one per round, so add each round's
+                # prompt_len. If the server returns no usage, prompt_len falls
+                # back to the dataset row value, so the total is an estimate.
+                # Image tokens in multi-turn prompts are counted as text.
+                total_input += outputs[i].prompt_len
+                total_input_text += outputs[i].prompt_len
             if output_len > 1:
                 tpots.append((outputs[i].latency - outputs[i].ttft) / (output_len - 1))
             if use_retokenized_itl:

@@ -0,0 +1,121 @@
+"""Unit tests for multi-turn input token totals in calculate_metrics."""
+
+import unittest
+
+from sglang.benchmark.datasets.common import DatasetRow
+from sglang.benchmark.serving import (
+    RequestFuncInput,
+    RequestFuncOutput,
+    calculate_metrics,
+)
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class _FakeTokenizer:
+    def encode(self, text, add_special_tokens=False):
+        if not isinstance(text, str):
+            raise ValueError("text input must be of type `str`")
+        return text.split()
+
+
+def _successful_output(prompt_len: int) -> RequestFuncOutput:
+    return RequestFuncOutput(
+        generated_text="ok",
+        success=True,
+        latency=0.2,
+        ttft=0.05,
+        prompt_len=prompt_len,
+        output_len=1,
+        start_time=0.0,
+    )
+
+
+class TestCalculateMetricsMultiTurnInput(CustomTestCase):
+    def _metrics(self, outputs, input_requests=None, dur_s=1.0):
+        metrics, _ = calculate_metrics(
+            input_requests=input_requests,
+            outputs=outputs,
+            dur_s=dur_s,
+            tokenizer=_FakeTokenizer(),
+            backend="sglang-oai-chat",
+        )
+        return metrics
+
+    def test_multiturn_server_usage_sums_round_prompt_lens(self):
+        metrics = self._metrics([_successful_output(100), _successful_output(240)])
+        self.assertEqual(metrics.total_input, 340)
+        self.assertEqual(metrics.total_input_text, 340)
+        self.assertEqual(metrics.total_input_vision, 0)
+        self.assertGreater(metrics.input_throughput, 0)
+
+    def test_failed_requests_are_not_counted(self):
+        failed = RequestFuncOutput(success=False, prompt_len=999, generated_text="")
+        metrics = self._metrics(
+            [_successful_output(100), _successful_output(240), failed]
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(metrics.total_input, 340)
+        self.assertEqual(metrics.total_input_text, 340)
+        self.assertEqual(metrics.total_input_vision, 0)
+
+    def test_single_turn_totals_come_from_input_requests(self):
+        input_requests = [
+            DatasetRow(
+                prompt="a cat",
+                prompt_len=30,
+                output_len=8,
+                text_prompt_len=20,
+                vision_prompt_len=10,
+            ),
+            DatasetRow(
+                prompt="a dog",
+                prompt_len=70,
+                output_len=8,
+                text_prompt_len=40,
+                vision_prompt_len=30,
+            ),
+        ]
+        # Server-reported lengths must not replace the dataset split.
+        outputs = [_successful_output(1000), _successful_output(2000)]
+        metrics = self._metrics(outputs, input_requests=input_requests)
+        self.assertEqual(metrics.total_input, 100)
+        self.assertEqual(metrics.total_input_text, 60)
+        self.assertEqual(metrics.total_input_vision, 40)
+
+    def test_missing_usage_falls_back_to_dataset_row_prompt_len(self):
+        """Fallback when the server returns no usage.
+
+        init_new copies the dataset row prompt_len and nothing overwrites it.
+        Two successful turns of a 100-token row therefore total 200, which is
+        an estimate of the dataset row rather than measured server usage.
+        """
+        request = RequestFuncInput(
+            prompt=["turn-1", "turn-2"],
+            api_url="http://127.0.0.1/v1/chat/completions",
+            prompt_len=100,
+            output_len=8,
+            model="dummy",
+            lora_name="",
+            image_data=None,
+            extra_request_body={},
+        )
+        outputs = []
+        for _ in range(2):
+            output = RequestFuncOutput.init_new(request)
+            output.success = True
+            output.generated_text = "ok"
+            output.output_len = 1
+            output.latency = 0.2
+            output.ttft = 0.05
+            outputs.append(output)
+            self.assertEqual(output.prompt_len, 100)
+
+        metrics = self._metrics(outputs)
+        self.assertEqual(metrics.total_input, 200)
+        self.assertEqual(metrics.total_input_text, 200)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
